stem.text: Three coplanar forces act on a block.
Which diagram shows the directions of the forces such that the block could be in equilibrium?

A.alt: Square block with a diagonal arrow pointing up and to the right from a dot on its upper part, a vertical arrow pointing down from a dot on its lower middle, and a horizontal arrow pointing left from a dot on its bottom edge.

B.alt: Square block with a diagonal arrow pointing up and to the left from a dot inside its upper left, a vertical arrow pointing down from a dot in its middle, and a horizontal arrow pointing right from a dot on its bottom edge.

C.alt: Square block with a horizontal arrow pointing right from a dot on its top edge, a vertical arrow pointing down from a dot in its middle, and a diagonal arrow pointing down and to the right from a dot on its bottom-right corner.

D.alt: Square block with two upward arrows from dots in its upper part and a downward arrow from a dot in its middle.
